remarks: Luxury Townhome on the Darien Border - Move-In Ready! Discover sophisticated living in this stunning end-unit townhome offering 2,501 sq ft across 4 levels with a convenient attached garage. Perfectly positioned on the Darien/Stamford border, it's a commuter's dream - walking distance to Noroton and Glenbrook train stations, with nearby parks, beaches, restaurants, and shopping. The main level features an inviting open-concept living and dining area with double windows, interior shutters, abundant natural light, gleaming hardwood floors, and elegant custom moldings. The gourmet kitchen shines with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, ample cabinetry, and a large pantry. A slider opens to a private fenced outdoor space with a beautiful slate patio. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat with a tiled spa bath, double sinks, huge California walk-in closet, and a private balcony. An additional bedroom and a tiled full bath complete the second level. The third floor loft offers a large multi-purpose room featuring dramatic cathedral ceilings and flexibility as a guest room, playroom, or office. The finished lower level provides a spacious family/rec room with stylish coffered walls, a powder room, laundry room, and generous storage. This meticulously maintained home blends luxury finishes with practical commuter convenience. Don't miss this rare opportunity in one of the area's most desirable locations!
